risks: Root-owned concurrent wave0 edits can invalidate hashes and line ranges; report is inspection evidence, not an integration-ready diff against an unverified future commit.
Changing ROOM_PROVIDER_DECISION alone cannot enable anything: joinRoom, joinNativeRoom and Conation wrapper all separately prevent a live result; merely removing assertions would fabricate success.
Existing caller-supplied actor/grant and hardcoded recording consent must not cross into shared authority. Agent allow-all never overrides resource ACL.

MeetingRepository.pending contains a tautological filter. Journal read can quarantine/rewrite corrupt tails and constructor creates directories; no executable journal read was performed because that would violate preflight immutability.
Local journal command-ID dedupe lacks common request-hash conflict semantics and is not a cross-process PostgreSQL active-channel/provider uniqueness boundary.
Provider room provisioning is an external effect: timeout/crash requires reconciliation under stable identity, not blind retry or fabricated applied receipt.

Revocation must actually eject all connected devices and reject renewal before TTL expiry; unavailable ejection needs a typed pending fence and durable recovery, not successful revoke based on token TTL.
Two normative SQL filenames overlap conceptually; root must use selected migrator and prevent duplicate call/receipt/user tables or fabricated timestamps.
Published apiChanges and domainApiContracts disagree in names and omit EndCall/GetCall schemas; treating the shorter DTO list as complete would weaken archive/revoke/concurrency acceptance.

WP-31 full completeness lists search/mentions/attention/agent integrations not in direct DAG edges. Keep those as explicit integration prerequisites, not silently N/A and not a second implementation of those domains.

CALL-01 includes downstream guest/screen-share/recording/transcript pipelines. Preserve WP-31 metadata-only archive and standalone regression, do not silently require ASR or implement WP-32-35 inside this worker package.
Channel guest policy needs named decision; normative WP-31 three-user success should use three authorized channel members plus a separate denied outsider, not accidental guest grant expansion.
Real two-device media/TURN/OS permissions and three-member evidence remain external runtime prerequisites; provider probes, adapter tests, local preview and intent journals cannot replace them.

Optional Macro one-call-per-principal restriction is not decided in the record; choose and document explicitly rather than accidentally conflating it with mandatory one active call/room for concurrent channel StartCall.
